enchantment.carianstyle.beast_vitality.d: Beneficial and negative effect duration extended by [Enchantment Level]*30%
enchantment.carianstyle.freezing_earthqu: After receiving 25% max health damage, launch all creatures within ([Enchantment Level]-1)*3+5 blocks with [Enchantment Level]*0.35 force, and inflict [Enchantment Level] level Frostbite for [Enchantment Level]*5 seconds: Movement speed decreases by [Effect Level]*7.5%, take [Effect Level]*0.25% max health as Frostbite damage every 0.5 seconds (Physical damage type, damage increases by 100% per level)

config.carianstyle.title: Carian Style Configuration
config.carianstyle.enableDetailedLogging:
When enabled, all detailed information will be logged
Including: Enchantment trigger, attribute calculation, event handling, etc.
§c⚠ Warning: Will produce large amount of log output!§r
§cOnly enable when debugging!§r
Fill in enchantment IDs you want to disable
You can find enchantment IDs in language files
§7Example:§r ["scarlet_rot", "doomed_death"]
Disabled enchantments will:
• Not be registered in game
• Cannot be obtained from enchanting table
• Cannot be obtained through commands
config.carianstyle.rockBlasterMaxRange.t:
Maximum mining radius of Rock Blaster enchantment
§710§r = Maximum 10 block radius (default)
Determines how many blocks can be mined in each direction
Higher values allow faster mining but may cause lag
§cRecommended not to exceed 15§r
config.carianstyle.prayerfulStrikeMaxHea:
Set maximum stackable health cap for Prayerful Strike enchantment
§71000§r = Maximum 1000 health points (default)
This limits the maximum additional health from kills
Prevents infinite health stacking
config.carianstyle.isTreasureVeryRareEnc:
Convert all Very Rare enchantments to Treasure enchantments
§7false§r = Normal enchantments (default)
§7true§r = Convert to Treasure enchantments
Treasure enchantments cannot be obtained from enchanting table, only from loot
config.carianstyle.isTreasureRareEnchant:
Convert all Rare enchantments to Treasure enchantments
§7false§r = Normal enchantments (default)
§7true§r = Convert to Treasure enchantments
config.carianstyle.isTreasureUncommonEnc:
Convert all Uncommon enchantments to Treasure enchantments
§7false§r = Normal enchantments (default)
§7true§r = Convert to Treasure enchantments
config.carianstyle.levelLimit.tooltip:
Set limits for some enchantments beyond level cap
To prevent being overpowered
§7false§r = No limit (default)
§7true§r = Enable level limits
When enabled, enchantment effects will be limited even at higher levels
Set enchanting difficulty multiplier
§71.0§r = Default difficulty (default)
Higher values increase enchanting cost
Making enchantments harder to obtain
§7Example:§r
• 2.0 = Double difficulty
• 0.5 = Half difficulty
config.carianstyle.enableTrueDamage.tool:
When enabled, use complex field detection to bypass armor and protection
This makes true damage work on all creatures (including modded ones)
§7true§r = Use advanced detection (Recommended, default)
§7false§r = Use simple setHealth method

§cNote:§r When disabled, some modded creatures may not take true damage
But performance will be slightly better
